THE classic 4x strategy game.  Way ahead of its time in cinematic, graphics, and design of the interface.  The game just feels so good to play.  The campaigns are where it really shines.  Map is randomly generated.  Events periodically occur, also partially random.  This makes for a unique experience every time.  I've played this game over and over, both in the past and recently and it always feels fresh.  Space battles look and feel incredible.  Ground battles are less good but still fun. 
 Colony management is interesting and you can be as involved as you want to be with it or just set them all to autobuild if you find the process tedious, which is a perfectly adequate way to play.  Diplomacy is kinda meh but once you figure out how it works you can definitely work the system.  Many espionage options in the game.  You can easily go through an entire campaign without using any one element.  This allows you to al la carte build your own path to victory and gives a lot in variety in how any given situation can be approached.  So much replayability  just from that alone.  

Brought to you by a talented Hungarian developer team, this game still holds up today and I highly recommend checking it out, as a fan of the genre or even a total newbie. I will say Hard difficulty is not balanced very well and you are pretty much required to play in a way that conquers the map well before the story events play out.  If it's your first playthrough, definitely play normal or easy so you can really enjoy this gem of a game.  Music is so good, really gets the vibe going.

Ez egy nagyon jó űr-stratégiai játék, a gyerekkorom egyik meghatározó játéka, és magyar szinkronnal van, ami még élvezhetőbbé teszi. Egy hadjáratot 4-5 óra alatt végig lehet vinni, de ez alatt fejleszteni kell űrhajókat és tankokat, kolonizálni kell bolygókat amik adót fizetnek neked, de ne legyen túl magas, mert akkor fellázadnak, stb.  Három fajjal lehet játszani, az egyik az ember, a másik kettő idegen. Lehet harcolni mindenki ellen, de diplomáciával szövetségeket is köthetsz más fajokkal. Az a jó benne, hogy sokféle képpen végződhet, és ez csak rajtad múlik. 

Ez egy 1999-es játék, de grafikában és a játékmenetben még ma is megállja a helyét.

This game in 1999 blew my mind, so far ahead of its time, you got space battles, you got ground battles, you got colony building and management, you got ship design, you got space stations, you got spies, diplomacy and the option to marry a pirates daughter for some early game merc ships. Oh, and you can choose between a few races for different styles of play...

It is 700MB in size, but this game is big, the star map is impressive.

The only reason I want a remake of this is that when your fleets get too big, space battles are auto resolved, this is the latter parts of the game, the concept was well beyond the limitations of computers back then.

Steam says 14 hours on record, that was a nostalgia play through, which I lost, twice haha, pre steam tracking my game play, several hundred hours, probably in between some command and conquer dial up sessions. The campaign is not that long, but, you lose, you lose, and you will lose. You may not know you have lost, and fruitlessly carry on with no way to win, but it feels good and that loss drives you to try again. It is in no way impossible, but if you crack this on first play through, I tip my hat!

If you are a stellaris fan, it is worth getting just to see what started it all really.
